name: clickhouse
description: ClickHouse HTTP interface: read-only parameterised queries (readonly=1, time and result caps), databases, tables and columns, JSONEachRow inserts; DDL node only

nodes.title: Ping server
nodes.description: Health check: "Ok." when the server is up (no authentication needed)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Run read-only query
nodes.description: Run one read-only SQL statement (SELECT, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN) with readonly=1, a time limit and result caps; returns JSON {meta, data, rows, statistics}

sql.description: One SQL statement; use {name:Type} placeholders with `parameters` for values

database.description: Default database for unqualified table names

max_execution_time.description: Server-side time limit in seconds (max_execution_time, at most 120)

max_result_bytes.description: Uncompressed byte cap for the result (agent tools: at most 10485760)

result_overflow_mode.description: throw: fail when a cap is hit; break: return the rows read so far

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Insert rows
nodes.description: Insert rows (objects of column: value) into a table as JSONEachRow; returns written_rows (as an agent tool only when CLICKHOUSE_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

database.description: Database of the table (default: the user's default database)

max_execution_time.description: Server-side time limit in seconds (max_execution_time, at most 120)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
